answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a tundra that rotates unpredictably. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the dune of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. The dawn ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal 1ampm.
